meta.name: ai-ready
meta.description: Make any repo AI-ready — analyzes your codebase and generates AGENTS.md, copilot-instructions.md, CI workflows, issue templates, and more. Mines your PR review patterns and creates files customized to your stack. USE THIS SKILL when the user asks to "make this repo ai-ready", "set up AI config", or "prepare this repo for AI contributions".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动为代码仓库生成AI协作配置文件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想让代码仓库对AI工具更友好，自动生成配置和模板。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically generate AI collaboration config files for your repo
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to make your codebase AI-friendly with auto-generated configs and templates.

howto.what: 装上此技能后，当你说“让仓库为AI做好准备”，Claude 会分析你的代码仓库，生成 AGENTS.md、copilot-instructions.md、CI 工作流、Issue 模板等文件，并根据你的 PR 审查模式和技术栈定制这些文件。
howto.when: 当你说“make this repo ai-ready”、“set up AI config”或“prepare this repo for AI contributions”时触发。

say.text: 让这个仓库 AI 就绪。
say.note: 触发分析并生成配置文件。

say.text: 为这个仓库设置 AI 配置。
准备这个仓库以便 AI 贡献。

howto.what_en: After installing this skill, when you say "make this repo AI-ready", Claude analyzes your codebase and generates AGENTS.md, copilot-instructions.md, CI workflows, issue templates, and more, customized to your stack and PR review patterns.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "make this repo ai-ready", "set up AI config", or "prepare this repo for AI contributions".

say_en.text: Set up AI config for this repo.
Prepare this repo for AI contributions.
